blurb: YogaSix offers six signature yoga classes focusing on strength, agility, flexibility, and balance. Classes include Y6 Signature, Y6 Slow Flow, Y6 Power Flow, Y6 Sculpt, Y6 Restore, and Y6 Core. They also offer specialty classes like Y6 Mix and Y6 TRX, suitable for all levels including beginners.
